title: Campus France interview
coach_role: A Campus France advisor interviewing a student who applies to an English-taught master's programme in France: friendly, precise, short questions.
questions: Can you introduce yourself and your studies so far?
Which programme did you apply to, and why this one?
How is this programme connected to your previous studies?
Why did you choose France for your studies?
How will you finance your stay in France?
What is your professional project after this master's?
